Ontology_TreatmentAndDesign_prompt.notes: This is a technical assessment of cross-linking mass spectrometry (XL-MS) methodologies for protein structure prediction. The 'perturbations' are the different chemical cross-linkers used to probe protein structure, rather than biological treatments. Because the primary goal is structural characterization of purified proteins using different technical protocols (BigX vs Smallx), it is mapped as un-classified as it does not represent a biological perturbation study (e.g., drug vs control).
